headline: Four UV filters behind a broad spectrum SPF 50

layout_description: Square 1080x1080. Hero line 'SPF 50' and headline top-left. Subhead below it. Three ingredient-to-role proof points stacked down the left half, each with a thin line marker (the competitor's ingredient tag cards, rebuilt as calm text rows). Real pack shot on the right 45%, lying at a slight angle on the flat-lay surface. CTA bottom-left; footnote along the bottom edge.

A smooth off-white surface with a subtle fine-grain paper texture, lit by soft natural daylight from the top-left, with two or three small smooth pale stone pebbles and a thin sliver of soft sunlight near the lower edge. Palette of off-white, pale sand and soft warm grey, clinical and minimal. Keep the right 45% of the frame as clear, evenly lit empty space, reserved for a photo composited later. Keep the left 50% calm and low-detail as empty space for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Kept: the ingredient flat-lay structure (pack on a styled surface with ingredient-to-benefit tags beside it). Replaced the competitor's actives with our four UV filters and vitamins from F5, F6, F22-F24. Lab SPF 56.6 kept only in the footnote; labelled SPF 50 is the claim. Override: the archetype skill picked layout 'hero' for this ingredient_explainer reference; kept 'hero' as instructed.
